title: Creamy Garlic Pasta
description: A quick, silky Italian comfort dish with sautéed garlic, heavy cream, freshly grated parmesan, and al dente pasta.

steps.title: Boil Pasta
steps.description: Boil salted water and cook pasta al dente (8-9 min). Reserve 1/2 cup starchy pasta water before draining.

steps.title: Sauté Aromatics
steps.description: Sauté sliced garlic gently in olive oil until fragrant and pale golden, avoiding browning.

steps.title: Emulsify Sauce
steps.description: Stir in cream and grated parmesan until smooth, then toss the drained hot pasta through the pan.

title: Grilled Chicken Bowl
description: Grilled chicken breast over quinoa with avocado, cherry tomatoes, and a tahini drizzle.

steps.title: Grill Chicken
steps.description: Season chicken breast and grill 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through.

steps.title: Assemble Bowl
steps.description: Layer quinoa, sliced chicken, avocado, and tomatoes in a bowl.

steps.title: Drizzle & Serve
steps.description: Drizzle with tahini and serve warm.

title: Avocado Toast & Egg
description: Toasted sourdough topped with smashed avocado, a soft poached egg, and chili flakes.

steps.title: Toast Bread
steps.description: Toast sourdough slices until golden and crisp.

steps.title: Poach Egg
steps.description: Poach the egg in gently simmering water for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.description: Smash avocado onto toast, top with the poached egg and chili flakes.

title: Spicy Miso Ramen
description: Steaming ramen noodles in a spicy miso broth with chashu pork, bamboo shoots, and a marinated egg.

steps.title: Prepare Broth
steps.description: Simmer stock with miso paste until dissolved and fragrant.

steps.title: Cook Noodles
steps.description: Cook ramen noodles according to package instructions.

steps.title: Assemble Bowl
steps.description: Combine noodles and broth, top with chashu, egg, and chili oil.

title: Chocolate Pancakes
description: Fluffy chocolate pancakes stacked high with melted dark chocolate sauce and fresh raspberries.

steps.title: Make Batter
steps.description: Whisk flour, cocoa powder, and milk into a smooth batter.

steps.title: Cook Pancakes
steps.description: Cook batter in a hot pan, 2 minutes per side, until fluffy.

steps.title: Top & Serve
steps.description: Stack pancakes, drizzle with melted chocolate, and top with raspberries.

title: 15-min Mediterranean Salad
description: A fresh salad of cucumber ribbons, olives, tomatoes, and feta bathed in olive oil.

steps.title: Prep Vegetables
steps.description: Ribbon the cucumber and halve the tomatoes.

steps.title: Combine & Dress
steps.description: Toss vegetables with olives, feta, and olive oil.

steps.title: Season & Serve
steps.description: Season with oregano and serve immediately.

title: Garlic Butter Salmon
description: Pan-seared salmon fillet basted with garlic herb butter, thyme, and lemon.

steps.title: Sear Salmon
steps.description: Sear salmon skin-side down in a hot skillet for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Baste with Butter
steps.description: Flip, add butter, garlic, and thyme, and baste continuously.

steps.title: Rest & Serve
steps.description: Rest briefly, then serve with lemon slices.

title: Chicken Teriyaki Bowl
description: Charred glazed chicken over steamed rice with sesame seeds, broccoli, and scallions.

steps.title: Cook Chicken
steps.description: Sear chicken thighs until browned, then glaze with teriyaki sauce.

steps.title: Steam Broccoli
steps.description: Steam broccoli florets until tender-crisp.

steps.title: Assemble Bowl
steps.description: Serve sliced chicken and broccoli over rice, topped with sesame seeds.

title: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
description: Earthy arborio rice risotto with sautéed wild mushrooms and aged parmigiano-reggiano.

steps.title: Sauté Mushrooms
steps.description: Sauté mushrooms until golden, then set aside.

steps.title: Toast & Deglaze Rice
steps.description: Toast rice, deglaze with wine, then add hot stock gradually while stirring.

steps.title: Finish Risotto
steps.description: Stir in parmesan and mushrooms, then serve immediately.

title: Berry Acai Smoothie Bowl
description: Deep purple açai smoothie bowl topped with blueberries, strawberries, coconut, and granola.

steps.title: Blend Base
steps.description: Blend açai puree with banana until thick and smooth.

steps.title: Pour & Top
steps.description: Pour into a bowl and arrange blueberries, granola, and coconut on top.

title: Artisan Sourdough Pizza
description: Wood-fired-style sourdough pizza with San Marzano tomato sauce, buffalo mozzarella, and basil.

steps.title: Prepare Base
steps.description: Spread tomato sauce evenly over the sourdough base.

steps.title: Add Toppings
steps.description: Tear mozzarella over the sauce and drizzle with olive oil.

steps.title: Bake
steps.description: Bake at maximum oven temperature until the crust is blistered and cheese is bubbling.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Top with fresh basil leaves before serving.

title: Matcha Green Tea Crepes
description: Delicate stacked matcha mille crepes layered with whipped vanilla cream.

steps.title: Make Batter
steps.description: Whisk flour, matcha powder, milk, and eggs into a thin batter.

steps.title: Cook Crepes
steps.description: Cook thin crepes one at a time in a hot non-stick pan.

steps.title: Layer & Chill
steps.description: Layer crepes with whipped cream and chill before slicing.

title: Greek Quinoa Salad
description: Crisp tri-color quinoa salad with cucumber, tomatoes, olives, and feta in a lemon herb dressing.

steps.title: Prep Vegetables
steps.description: Dice cucumber and halve the cherry tomatoes.

steps.title: Combine & Dress
steps.description: Toss quinoa with vegetables, olives, feta, and lemon dressing.

steps.title: Chill & Serve
steps.description: Chill briefly before serving for best flavor.

title: Vegan Buddha Bowl
description: A colorful bowl of roasted chickpeas, sweet potato, kale, and tahini dressing.

steps.title: Roast Vegetables
steps.description: Roast cubed sweet potato and chickpeas at 200°C until crisp.

steps.title: Massage Kale
steps.description: Massage kale with a little olive oil and lemon juice.

steps.title: Assemble Bowl
steps.description: Combine everything in a bowl and drizzle with tahini dressing.

title: Iced Matcha Latte
description: A refreshing iced latte whisked from ceremonial-grade matcha and chilled oat milk.

steps.title: Whisk Matcha
steps.description: Whisk matcha powder with hot water until smooth and frothy.

steps.title: Pour & Serve
steps.description: Pour over ice and top with chilled oat milk.
